title: Lantern: Quarterly roadmap for Hosted API + Model Catalog convergence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: deliver a coordinated quarterly plan ("Lantern") that aligns Hosted API feature rollouts with model-catalog gating, canary windows, and OKR metrics so customers experience predictable latency/cost improvements without regressions. Scope: prioritize three surface areas — (1) routing policies for automatic fallbacks to compatible quantized model variants, (2) catalog metadata for compatibility/versioning and rollout signals, (3) dashboard and alerting surface for model health tied to prompt-based evals. Success metrics: reduce 95th pct latency for common routes by 10%, lower median cost-per-token for targeted workloads by 8%, and maintain model-quality regression rate <0.5% on critical eval sets.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap approved by eng/design/security stakeholders and prioritized in 2026-Q1 planning
Canary plan and rollout windows documented with rollback criteria and automated flags
Model-catalog schema extension merged (compatibility fields, qualitative tags, recommended quantization profiles)
Hosted API routing policy implemented behind a feature flag and validated in staging with synthetic traffic
Dashboards created showing per-model token-cost, 95th/50th latency, and prompt-set quality regression alerts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: model regressions introduced by automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants. Mitigation: require paired eval sets and automatic A/B comparison; block rollout if regression >0.5%
Risk: rollout coordination misses a dependent Dedicated change. Mitigation: dependency gating (ENG-2710) and cross-team readiness signoff two weeks prior
Risk: observability blindspots on routing decisions. Mitigation: add trace-level breadcrumbs and sampling for the first 72 hours of canary
Risk: customers perceive increased variability in answers. Mitigation: opt-in pilot for specific customers and explicit release notes + opt-out per-route flag
decisions: Decision: use model-catalog driven routing metadata (recommended_quant_profile, compatibility_level) rather than hardcoded mapping
Decision: start with three target routes (text-gen-standard, chat-slim, embeddings-optimized) for Q1 rollout
Decision: require security review for any customer-facing opt-out UI; internal feature flags do not trigger review
Decision: adopt nightly regression evaluation and stop-gap alerting to webhook channel #model-regressions
